steps.title: I arrive at the office.
steps.body: I walk in with my helper. It might be busy.

steps.title: I check in at the front desk.
steps.body: I say my name. There may be forms. My helper can help me fill them in.

notice.text: a little nervous. That is okay.

steps.title: I wait in the waiting room.
steps.body: I sit and wait for my name. I can bring something I like.

steps.title: The nurse checks my blood pressure.
steps.body: A band goes on my arm. It squeezes tight for a few seconds. Then it lets go.

steps.title: I meet my new doctor.
steps.body: They do not know me yet. I can tell them what is normal for me. I can tell them what is new.

notice.text: It is okay to take my time.

steps.title: The doctor checks my body.
steps.body: They listen to my heart. They look in my ears and my mouth.

steps.title: I'm done. I can go home.
steps.body: We say goodbye. I did it!
